NYT OPINION: "Mexico Can't Go On This Way"
June 5, 2026 | 🔴

📰 NYT opinion frames Sheinbaum's government as existentially compromised by cartel influence inside Morena. "Can't Go On This Way" is regime-change ad copy. Google News still indexes the piece under an earlier title — "Trump Wants Results Against Crime in Mexico. Can Sheinbaum Deliver?" Same article, two pitches in 48 hours.

🇲🇽 Paywalled, so no body quotes. The URL slug — mexico-sheinbaum-cartels-corruption — already tells you the verdict.

💀 Same week WSJ ran "Mexico is starting to push back against Trump's pressure campaign." NYT's answer: question the legitimacy of the pushback.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>$19.676 BILLION IN REMITTANCES Q1 — TRUMP'S DEPORTATION THEATER VS. THE DIASPORA</u>

El Financiero on the latest Banxico data: Mexico received $19,676 million USD in remittances January–April 2026, +2.6% year-over-year — the largest cuatrimestre on the historical record. April alone hit $4,978 million, +3.7% annual.

The quiet metric inside the headline: 12.4 million transactions in April, with an average send of $403 USD — up 5.5% per remittance. Banxico's read: "cada transacción es por un mayor monto de dinero." Fewer sends, bigger sends, more dollars hitting Michoacán, Oaxaca, Guerrero, Zacatecas.

Every ICE raid, every deportation flight, every Trump tariff threat — and the Mexican diaspora in the United States sends home a record. Soft power no executive order can repeal.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>AIRBNB IN 1,455 MEXICAN MUNICIPIOS — 2.5% OF HOSTS OWN THE MARKET</u>

Regeneración digs into Airbnb's real Mexico footprint: 254,000+ active listings spread across 1,455 municipalities — and just 2.5% of "hosts" (corporate investors, not families with a spare room) control the most profitable units, acting as financial intermediaries inside the real estate market.

UNAM researcher Patricia Olivera Martínez: "la vida dentro de estos sitios se encarece muchísimo y eso genera desplazamientos." Inside Airbnb founder Murray Cox is blunter — the platform has become "una herramienta económica para incentivar la conversión de viviendas en alojamiento turístico."

The pitch was gig-economy housing democracy. The reality is an extraction layer turning Mexico City, Playa, Oaxaca, Mérida into hotels with no zoning.

🇲🇽🇵🇸 <u>72,315 PALESTINIANS DEAD, 92% OF GAZA HOUSING HIT — "CEASEFIRE" WAS A PRESS RELEASE</u>

OCHA numbers that Contralínea pulled from the UN dossier: 72,315 Palestinians killed and 172,137 wounded since October 7, 2023. Approximately 92% of all housing in Gaza damaged or destroyed by evacuation orders and bombing. UNRWA banned from the entire Occupied Palestinian Territory since March 2025.

UN High Commissioner Volker Türk: "el desplazamiento mismo se ha vuelto una amenaza para la vida." Palestinians face danger walking, driving, simply being outdoors.

It has been six months since the October 10, 2025 ceasefire was announced. Attacks continue across Beit Lahia, Jabalia, Khan Younis, Rafah. The Western press moved on. The killing did not.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>IRAN'S DECENTRALIZED RESISTANCE OUTLASTS US WAR — 65% OF AMERICANS WANT OUT</u>

Contralínea analysis: after 10,000 Western strike targets and "limited defensive results," Washington itself declared Iranian regime change "obsolete" by April 2026. Tehran's decentralized command — power split across president, parliament, IRGC, and Mojtaba Khamenei after his father's death in February — absorbed the blow without collapse.

The Strait of Hormuz, carrying 20% of global oil, sent crude up ~50% the day after Iran flexed transit control. As sociologist Peyman Vahabzadeh frames it, Iran imposes "consecuencias económicas mundiales" without firing first.

Now 65% of Americans oppose continuing the war. Empire is learning the Vietnam lesson the long way.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>SHEINBAUM: "WE WILL NOT ACCEPT JUSTICE FROM ANOTHER COUNTRY"</u>

Sheinbaum from the mañanera, refusing every demand to distance herself from AMLO: "Somos el segundo piso de la Cuarta Transformación, que tiene los cimientos del gobierno de López Obrador." Direct rejection of the US push to subordinate Mexican justice to gringo verdicts — "quieren que la justicia no se haga en México, sino en otro país, incluso sin pruebas."

The move came after AMLO's public letter to the nation defending Mexico from Trump's offensive — and the predictable conservative campaign that followed. 4T continuity hardens as the foreign pressure escalates.

🇲🇽🇨🇺 <u>RAÚL CASTRO REAPPEARS — 95 YEARS, OLIVE GREEN, FULL DEFIANCE</u>

Raúl Castro walked into Havana's Karl Marx Theater Friday in his olive-green uniform — first public appearance since the Trump DOJ's May indictment over the 1996 plane downing. 95th birthday, standing ovation, Díaz-Canel and the entire military top brass on stage with him.

The ceremony doubled as the 65th anniversary of Cuba's Ministry of Interior. Trump's "maximum pressure" wanted Cuba isolated. Instead it got a reunion photo of the whole revolutionary state closing ranks — China publicly condemning US pressure on the same day.

🇲🇽🏭 <u>QUERÉTARO Q1 FDI JUMPS 51% TO $456M — REINVESTED PROFITS ALONE TOPPED $481M</u>

El Economista: Querétaro pulled $456.3M USD in foreign direct investment in Q1 2026 — up 51.1% from $302M a year earlier. Reinvested profits hit $481M (+87.3%); new capital $380.2M (vs $21.7M YoY). US: 63%, Germany: 16.3%, Spain: 10.3%. Manufacturing captured 47.1%.

Foreign capital doesn't reinvest record sums in a "narco-state." It reinvests where the rules are clear and Plan México is delivering. Trump's talking points keep colliding with the spreadsheet.

🇲🇽🏭 <u>US STEEL TARIFFS RAISE MEXICAN CONSTRUCTION COSTS 3–6% — SHEINBAUM'S INFRASTRUCTURE BUILD CAUGHT IN CROSSFIRE</u>

CMIC president Luis Méndez Jaled tells Regeneración that Trump's steel tariffs are pushing every Mexican construction project up 3–6%. Mexico burns ~28M tons/year, produces only 19–20M — that 8M-ton deficit must cross the tariff wall. Sheinbaum's passenger train alone needs ~1M tons.

The "free trade partner" weaponizes its steel. The answer: produce more here. AHMSA rescue, Pemex steel, vertical integration. Sovereignty isn't optional when your patron is the saboteur.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>ICE GRABS AYOTZINAPA EX-MILITARY HIDING IN CALIFORNIA — SHEINBAUM CONFIRMS</u>

Enrique Rodríguez Chávez, allegedly tied to the 2014 disappearance of the 43 normal-school students of Ayotzinapa, was detained yesterday in California during an ICE immigration raid. Sheinbaum confirmed today that agents found "una ficha relacionada con la orden de aprehensión" against him from Mexican courts.

For a decade, a man wanted for 43 enforced disappearances was living comfortably in the US. Calderón's army officers don't get persecuted by Washington — they get safe harbor. Until they don't.
